result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the 'Popular right now' listing has overlapping text that makes the metadata unreadable, plus a few truncation and consistency problems in the horizontal carousels.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar row, the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap each other ('25–35 min' collides with '€0 delivery'), producing an illegible string like '25–3S0 mdinlivery'.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the meta line as a single flex row with proper gaps/separators instead of absolutely positioned or overlapping text nodes, and allow the row to wrap or truncate cleanly.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and its title has no ellipsis or visible affordance that the list scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a max width to card titles and add a peek/partial card plus scroll indicator so horizontal scrolling is discoverable.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent backgrounds — one white circle, one dark circle — creating a mismatched look.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button style (e.g. semi-transparent white circle with dark icon) across all cards.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a partially rendered chip, and the second promo card is abruptly cut by the bottom navigation bar without any visual fade.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peeking for the chip row and bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards are not sliced by the fixed navigation.

issues.description: The notification bell badge and heart icons appear to be icon-only controls with no visible labels, and the '€0 delivery' / '−20%' badges rely on color alone for emphasis.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible names (aria-label) for icon-only buttons and ensure badge meaning is conveyed by text as well as color.
